comment: apps/tv-vega IS referenced here, and its @amazon-devices/* dependencies ARE
on the public npm registry — contrary to what this file said until
2026-09-15. They are installed as ordinary workspace dependencies, so a
fresh clone typechecks the Vega app like anything else.
`npm run typecheck:vega` still exists for checking the app alone.
The SDK needs one tsconfig concession — see apps/tv-vega/tsconfig.json
